name: container
title: Container
description: The page-width wrapper: a centred column with fluid gutters, five named widths and room for the notch.
docs: size is narrow (40rem), prose (46rem), default (72rem), wide (88rem) or full (no limit), and counts the gutters. The gutters are fluid, 16px on a phone growing to 32px on a desktop, and they add the safe-area inset, so content stays clear of a notch in landscape (the larger of the left and right inset on both sides, so the column stays centred). padded={false} turns the gutters off, for a Container inside another Container: it then only caps the width, so the padding never doubles. as renders main, section, header, footer, nav, article or aside instead of a div, which gives a page its landmarks without an extra wrapper. The gutter is available to anything inside as --container-gutter.
